title: Shot-based variational simulation of the toric code phase transition: Energy, global entanglement, and noise resilience
summary: We investigate the capability of variational quantum circuits in detecting a topological phase transition within the toric code model subjected to a uniform magnetic field. The detection is carried out via shot-based computations of both the ground state energy and the global entanglement. We begin by employing well-established renormalization techniques to construct a quantum circuit that accurately represents the pure toric code under periodic boundary condition.
